fullPassage: Socotra Island, a small island owned by Yemen and located in the Arabian Sea, looks as if it were part of another planet. In fact, it separated from the mainland of Africa six or seven million years ago, causing unique forms of life to develop on it. It is home to about 800 species of rare plants and animals, many of which are found nowhere else on earth. Because the island experiences extreme heat and frequent droughts, many of its plants have evolved unusual appearances. One striking example is the dragon's blood tree. Its branches make it look like a giant umbrella. It gets its name from a thick, red substance that comes out when its bark is cut. When this happens, it appears as if the tree were bleeding.

questions.passage: Socotra Island, a small island owned by Yemen and located in the Arabian Sea, looks as if it were part of another planet. In fact, it separated from the mainland of Africa six or seven million years ago, causing (A)[ordinary / unique] forms of life to develop on it. It is home to about 800 species of (B)[common / rare] plants and animals, many of which are found nowhere else on earth. Because the island experiences (C)[extreme / mild] heat and frequent droughts, many of its plants have evolved unusual appearances. One striking example is the dragon's blood tree. Its branches make it look like a giant umbrella. It gets its name from a thick, red substance that comes out when its bark is cut. When this happens, it appears as if the tree were bleeding.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unique=독특한 / ordinary=평범한 (B) rare=희귀한 / common=흔한 (C) extreme=극심한 / mild=온화한
det.analysis:
① unique—rare—extreme: 섬에서 '독특한' 생명체가 생겨났고 + '희귀한' 동식물의 서식지 + '극심한' 더위를 겪음 ←정답
② ordinary/mild: 평범한/온화한은 문맥과 반대
③ common: 다른 곳에 없는(nowhere else) 종이므로 '흔한'은 부적절
④ ordinary/common/mild: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 독특한(unique) 생명체, 희귀한(rare) 종, 극심한(extreme) 더위 흐름

④ drought: 비가 거의 오지 않아 물이 부족한 긴 기간 = 가뭄 ←정답
det.tip: little or no rain(비가 거의 없음) + shortage of water(물 부족) → drought(가뭄)

questions.passage: Because the island experiences extreme heat and frequent droughts, many of its plants have __________ (evolve) unusual appearances.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: evolve(진화하다) → evolved (현재완료 have + 과거분사)
det.analysis: evolve를 과거분사 evolved로 바꿔요. 앞에 have가 있으므로 '현재완료(have + 과거분사)' 형태가 필요해요. 'have evolved' = (지금까지) 진화해 왔다. 그래서 evolved.
det.tip: have 뒤에는 과거분사 → have evolved (현재완료)

questions.passage: Socotra Island, a small island owned by Yemen and __________ (locate) in the Arabian Sea, looks as if it were part of another planet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: locate(위치시키다) → located (과거분사, 수동 후치수식)
det.analysis: locate를 과거분사 located로 바꿔요. 섬은 바다에 '위치되어 있는' 대상이므로, 앞의 owned(소유된)와 나란히 과거분사 located가 명사 island를 뒤에서 꾸며요(수동의 뜻). 'located in the Arabian Sea' = Arabian 해에 위치한.
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 '~된' 수동으로 꾸미면 과거분사 → located in ~

questions.passage: Socotra Island, a small island owned by Yemen and located in the Arabian Sea, looks as if it were part of another planet. In fact, it separated from the mainland of Africa six or seven million years ago, causing unique forms of life to develop on it. It is home to about 800 species of rare plants and animals, many of which are __________. Because the island experiences extreme heat and frequent droughts, many of its plants have evolved unusual appearances. One striking example is the dragon's blood tree. Its branches make it look like a giant umbrella. It gets its name from a thick, red substance that comes out when its bark is cut. When this happens, it appears as if the tree were bleeding.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지구 어디에서도 발견되지 않는(found nowhere else on earth) = 그 섬에만 있는 희귀종
det.analysis:
① found nowhere else on earth (지구 어디에도 없는): 본토에서 분리되어 독자 진화한 '희귀한(rare)' 종이라는 앞 내용과 연결됨 ←정답
② sold in every local market (시장마다 팔리는): 희귀종과 반대 — 오답
③ raised on large modern farms (대형 농장에서 길러지는): 야생 희귀종과 안 맞음 — 오답
④ eaten by people around the world (전 세계인이 먹는): 문맥 무관 — 오답
det.tip: rare(희귀한) + 독자 진화 → found nowhere else on earth(그 섬에만 존재)

ch: eaten by people around the world

questions.passage: Socotra Island, a small island owned by Yemen and located in the Arabian Sea, looks as if it were part of another planet. In fact, it separated from the mainland of Africa six or seven million years ago, causing unique forms of life to develop on it. It is home to about 800 species of rare plants and animals, many of which are found nowhere else on earth. Because the island experiences extreme heat and frequent droughts, many of its plants have evolved unusual appearances. One striking example is the dragon's blood tree. Its branches make it look like a giant umbrella. It gets its name from a thick, red substance that comes out when its bark is cut. When this happens, it appears __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마치 나무가 피 흘리는 것처럼(as if the tree were bleeding) = 껍질에서 붉은 물질이 나오는 모습
det.analysis:
① before the rain begins (비가 오기 전에): 붉은 물질과 무관 — 오답
② that the branches are growing (가지가 자란다는): 껍질을 잘랐을 때의 모습과 무관 — 오답
③ because the leaves are falling (잎이 떨어져서): 붉은 물질과 무관 — 오답
④ as if the tree were bleeding (마치 나무가 피 흘리는 것처럼): 껍질을 자르면 붉은 물질이 나오므로 피 흘리는 것처럼 보임 ←정답
det.tip: 붉은 물질(red substance)이 나옴 → as if the tree were bleeding(피 흘리는 것처럼)

ch: as if the tree were bleeding
